label: Lofty
description: Manage real estate leads, notes, tasks and client communication

operations.name: get_profile
operations.description: Read the profile of the user whose key is connected.

operations.name: list_leads
operations.description: Read one page of leads; use offset or the returned scrollId for the next page.

operations.name: get_lead
operations.description: Read a lead by its ID.

operations.name: create_lead
operations.description: Create a lead; omitted assignee uses Lofty routing and omitted ownership defaults to the caller.

operations.name: update_lead
operations.description: Update supplied lead fields; omitted fields remain unchanged.

operations.name: delete_lead
operations.description: Move a lead to trash.

operations.name: list_notes
operations.description: List notes on a lead.

operations.name: get_note
operations.description: Read a note by its ID.

operations.name: create_note
operations.description: Add a note to a lead; returns the note ID, whose read may be briefly delayed.

operations.name: update_note
operations.description: Update a note on the specified lead.

operations.name: delete_note
operations.description: Delete a note.

operations.name: list_tasks
operations.description: List all tasks and appointments on a lead.

operations.name: get_task
operations.description: Read a task or appointment.

operations.name: create_task
operations.description: Create a follow-up task or appointment on a lead.

operations.name: update_task
operations.description: Update supplied task fields; use finish or unfinish to change completion.

operations.name: delete_task
operations.description: Delete a task or appointment.

operations.name: finish_task
operations.description: Mark a task completed; smart-plan tasks cannot be finished through this API.

operations.name: unfinish_task
operations.description: Reopen a completed task.

operations.name: send_email
operations.description: Send an email using the connected user’s outgoing email configuration.

operations.name: send_sms
operations.description: Send an SMS from the connected user’s active virtual number.

operations.name: list_tags
operations.description: List lead tags visible to the caller.

operations.name: list_members
operations.description: Read one page of team members.
